雷云大陆向来武者为尊，武者执天下牛耳，夺天地之造化，更有飞升成神者，故习武修仙者不计其数。
以武入道，突破天地法则的桎梏，成为高高在上的神仙，这是武者的毕生追求。然武道之路注定不平凡，一旦踏入，生死难料，但依然挡不住无数人习武修道的豪情壮志。我们的故事，也就是由此开始的。
白马国天佑二十三年，因抢夺一处矿藏，天狼国与白马国兵戎相见。双方各召集数十万大军在边境上大战一场，两国的武者也加入到这场争斗中。两国交战半年仍未分出胜负，双方由于国力耗损过大，民怨沸腾，统治者为了稳定民心而选择和谈。矿藏一分为二，由两国对半开采。
战事平息后，双方进入和平发展，举国欢腾，可作为边境战场的白马国天水城却遭了殃。半年的激战造成平民死伤无数，饿殍遍地，民不聊生。天水城内，到处是断壁残垣，白骨累累，侥幸活下来的平民都选择背井离乡，远离这个人间地狱。
安阳城。
这一日，安阳城沐浴在午后的阳光中，暖烘烘的。地主家的傻儿子钱小胖吃完午饭后在城内闲逛，一边走一边心满意足地剔着牙齿。嗯，方才那鸡不错，李大嘴——钱小胖家的厨子，手艺有长进，晚上再让他做一道来，钱小胖心道。
“少爷，赏几个子吧？两天没吃了。”一名脏兮兮地乞丐爬了过来拉住钱小胖的裤脚，可怜巴巴地哀求道。
钱小胖厌恶地甩开来，皱眉道：“去去去，天天都是两天没吃了，咋没饿死你？真是的，要饭也不要出点新意来，活该你挨饿！”
安阳城是距离白马国边境不足三百里的一座小城，前年天水城大战，天水城的百姓逃难，不少人就逃到了这里。由于缺乏谋生手段，不少人沦为乞丐，所以这两年内安阳城内乞丐剧增。
穷生恶胆，有些乞丐为了活下来，在城里生事，搅得城内不得安生。这些乞丐在城里不仅吃喝成问题，拉撒也成问题。他们中有些人在城内随地大小便，甚至敢当众撒尿，吓得城里好些女眷大白天也不敢出门。杀又不能杀，赶又赶不走，安阳城的官府可谓伤透了脑筋。
最后师爷想了个计策，把这些乞丐集中到一个叫污衣巷的地方，并且勒令他们不得越界到城内的其他地方。如若越界，一经发现，官差会将其乱棍打出。
但这样也不是办法，污衣巷本来就是贫民区，在安阳城以脏乱差闻名。再把大批乞丐赶进去，那可热闹了。昨天李家小子说他被乞丐打劫，今天王家闺女说她肚兜被偷了，明天张家二狗子说他媳妇上街被挤怀孕……
污衣巷内充斥着犯罪与饥寒，瘟疫横行，每天都在死人，全城居民唯恐避之不及。安阳城还算富庶，可每天都有贫民跑去诉苦，官府看不下去了，就联合一些富户定期施舍点粥，发点药。但杯水车薪，终归治不了“穷”这个病。
不过快两年过去了，情况反而好起来了，因为乞丐快死光了，十不存一，贫民中最穷的人也死了差不多了。人少了，事就少了。活下来的人都是命硬的，加上官府的接济，他们日子倒是好起来了。要知道官府的接济是定额的，并没有因为人少了就减少了，所以死的人多了，活着的人分到的就多了。就这样，官府的英明决策，拯救了全城，城主因此受到嘉奖。
经过优胜劣汰，留下来的乞丐倒是学乖了。为了生存，他们学会了一些法则。不再不随地大小便，也不偷不抢了，就老老实实地乞讨，做一名不让人讨厌的乞丐。污衣巷好起来了，摆脱了过去的脏乱差。官府为更人性化管理，让这些乞丐能生存下去，允许他们到别处去乞讨。
今日钱小胖遇到的，正是那些倒霉乞丐幸存下来的一员。对于他们，钱小胖可不会有什么同情心，就不耐烦地把他打发走了。后面又遇到几个乞丐，都被钱小胖连推带踹赶跑了。
“小叫花，少爷又来了。怎么样，上次的输的服不服气？”钱小胖走着走着，已经到了东城门下，冲着一个正靠在城门下捉虱子的乞丐道。
这是一个黑黑瘦瘦，头发乱糟糟，全身脏兮兮的小乞丐，看起来比钱小胖还小那么一两岁，瘦骨嶙峋的身体包裹在一身又脏又破的袍子中。这明显是件大人的衣服，也不知道是哪偷的还是捡来的。小乞丐苦着一张黑里泛黄的脸，眼巴巴地望着来往的行人客商，乞求着谁会往他的破碗中丢下一个铜钱。可一早上过去，一个子都没讨到。
这时候看见钱小胖过来，小乞丐眉眼中闪过一丝喜色，他的贵人来了。小叫花停止了捉虱子，将袍子紧了紧，说道：“服了服了，钱少爷真聪明，小叫花服了。”

钱小胖听了恭维，很是受用，哈哈笑了起来：“知道少爷聪明就好，我爹还老说我傻，也不知道他到底在想什么？”
钱小胖不爱搭理这城里的乞丐，却唯独不包含眼前的这个。大概是因为这小乞丐年纪小，看起来人畜无害的样子。钱小胖时不时就会过来捉弄他，当然也经常会赏他一两个子。时间长了，两个人也就认识了。
几日前钱小胖拿了几只煮熟的螃蟹，正在吃的时候遇到了这个小乞丐。然后钱小胖要逗他玩，就跟他打赌。说是问三个关于螃蟹的问题，小乞丐要是都答对，螃蟹就归他吃，如果答错的话，小乞丐就要站街上当众撒尿。这纯属是个恶作剧，伤害性不大，小乞丐满口答应。
第一个问题：螃蟹有几只眼睛？
答：两只。
第二个问题：螃蟹有几条腿？
答：八条。
第三个问题：螃蟹走路先出哪条腿？
……

Warriors have always been revered in Leiyun Continent. Warriors are the best in the world, seizing the fortune of heaven and earth, and some even ascend to become gods. Therefore, there are countless people who practice martial arts and become immortals.
Entering the Tao through martial arts, breaking through the shackles of the laws of heaven and earth, and becoming a supreme god, this is the lifelong pursuit of a warrior. However, the road to martial arts is destined to be extraordinary. Once you step on it, life or death will be unpredictable, but it still cannot stop countless people from their heroic ambition to practice martial arts and practice Taoism. This is where our story begins.
In the 23rd year of Tianyou's reign in the White Horse Kingdom, the Heavenly Wolf Kingdom and the White Horse Kingdom came into conflict with each other over the robbery of a mineral deposit. Both sides summoned hundreds of thousands of troops to fight on the border, and warriors from both countries also joined the fight. The two countries have been at war for half a year without a winner. Due to excessive depletion of national power, public dissatisfaction boiled over. The rulers chose peace talks in order to stabilize people's hearts. The mineral deposits were split in half and mined in half by both countries.
After the war subsided, the two sides entered into peaceful development and the whole country rejoiced. However, Tianshui City in the Kingdom of White Horse, which was a border battlefield, suffered disaster. Half a year of fierce fighting resulted in numerous civilian casualties, starvation and deprivation of life for the people. Tianshui City is full of broken walls and bones. The civilians who were lucky enough to survive chose to leave their homes and stay away from this hell on earth.
Anyang City.
On this day, Anyang City was bathed in the afternoon sun and was warm. Qian Xiaopang, the silly son of a landlord, wandered around the city after lunch, picking his teeth contentedly as he walked. Well, the chicken just now was good. Li Dazui, Qian Xiaopang’s cook, has improved his skills. Let him cook another one tonight, Qian Xiaopang thought.
"Master, how much money can I give you? I haven't eaten for two days." A dirty beggar crawled over and grabbed Xiaopang Qian's trousers, begging pitifully.
Qian Xiaopang threw it away in disgust and frowned: "Go, go, go, I haven't eaten for two days every day, why don't you starve to death? Really, don't come up with anything new when begging, you deserve to be hungry!"
Anyang City is a small city less than three hundred miles away from the border of Baima Kingdom. The people of Tianshui City fled during the battle in Tianshui City the year before last, and many people fled here. Due to lack of means of livelihood, many people have become beggars, so the number of beggars in Anyang City has increased dramatically in the past two years.
Poverty breeds cowardice. In order to survive, some beggars cause trouble in the city, causing trouble in the city. These beggars not only have a problem with eating and drinking in the city, but they also have a problem with diarrhea. Some of them defecated everywhere in the city, and even dared to urinate in public, which scared many women in the city and did not dare to go out in broad daylight. They can't kill them, but they can't drive them away. The officials in Anyang City are really worried.
Finally, the master came up with a plan to gather these beggars in a place called Dirty Clothes Alley, and ordered them not to cross the border to other places in the city. If someone crosses the line, once discovered, the officer will beat him with a stick.
But this is not a solution. Dirty Clothes Alley is originally a slum area and is famous for being dirty and messy in Anyang City. Then drive a large number of beggars in, and it will be lively. Yesterday the boy from the Li family said that he was robbed by beggars, today the daughter from the Wang family said that her bellyband was stolen, and tomorrow the son from the Zhang family said that his wife was forced to get pregnant while out on the street...
Dirty Clothes Alley is filled with crime, hunger and cold, the plague is rampant, people are dying every day, and the entire city residents are afraid to avoid it. Anyang City is still relatively prosperous, but poor people come to complain every day. The government can't stand it anymore, so they join forces with some wealthy households to regularly distribute porridge and medicine. But a drop in the bucket cannot cure the disease of "poverty".
However, almost two years have passed, and the situation has become better, because almost all the beggars are dead, not even one in ten, and the poorest among the poor are almost dead. When there are fewer people, there are fewer things to do. Those who survived were all hard-failed, and with the help from the government, their lives got better. You must know that the government's aid is a fixed amount, and it does not decrease because there are fewer people. Therefore, if there are more people who die, the living people will receive more. In this way, the wise decision of the government saved the whole city.The Lord was rewarded for this.
After the survival of the fittest, the remaining beggars learned the lesson. In order to survive, they learned some rules. I no longer defecate in the open, steal or rob, just beg honestly and be a beggar that is not annoying. Dirty Clothes Alley is getting better, getting rid of the mess of the past. In order to allow these beggars to survive, the government allowed them to beg elsewhere in order to provide more humane management.
What Qian Xiaopang met today was one of those unlucky beggars who survived. Qian Xiaopang had no sympathy for them, so he sent him away impatiently. Later, I met several beggars, but Qian Xiaopang pushed and kicked them away.
"Little beggar, the young master is here again. How is it? Are you convinced of your defeat last time?" Qian Xiaopang walked and arrived at the East City Gate. He said to a beggar who was leaning under the city gate to catch lice.
This was a dark and thin little beggar with messy hair and dirty body. He looked a year or two younger than Fatty Qian. His skinny body was wrapped in a dirty and torn robe. This is obviously an adult's clothing, and I don't know where it was stolen or picked up. The little beggar looked at the passers-by and merchants with a bitter look on his face, begging for someone to drop a copper coin into his broken bowl. But I went there all morning and didn't get a penny.
At this time, when he saw Fat Qian coming over, a hint of joy flashed in the little beggar's eyebrows, his noble man was here. The little beggar stopped catching lice, tightened his robe tightly, and said: "I'm convinced, I'm convinced. Master Qian is so smart, the little beggar is convinced."
Qian Xiaopang was very pleased with the compliment and laughed: "It's good to know that the young master is smart. My father always calls me stupid. I don't know what he is thinking?"
Qian Xiaopang didn't like to talk to beggars in this city, but he didn't like the one in front of him. Probably because this little beggar is young and looks harmless. Fatty Qian would come over to tease him from time to time, and of course he would often reward him with a piece or two. Over time, the two people got to know each other.
A few days ago, Xiaopang Qian took some cooked crabs and met this little beggar while eating them. Then Qian Xiaopang wanted to tease him and made a bet with him. It was said that three questions about crabs were asked. If the little beggar answered correctly, the crab would be his to eat. If the answer was wrong, the little beggar would stand on the street and urinate in public. This was purely a prank, not very harmful, and the little beggar agreed wholeheartedly.
The first question: How many eyes does a crab have?
Answer: Two.
Second question: How many legs does a crab have?
Answer: Eight.
The third question: Which leg does the crab come out first when it walks?
…
